services.desc: Discover the perfect Pilates class for your goals and explore our flexible pricing options. Our Group Reformer Class includes Towers, Pilates Arcs, and all of our specialized equipment and accessories available at our studio. The cables, bars, straps, and pulleys allow exercises to be done from a variety of positions, even standing. The resistance created by the pulley and spring system can provide a more challenging strength and endurance workout than mat classes.
